_doc: Which chains make up each House's reported posterior (read by combine_chains.py). Paths are relative to python/. 'drop_draws' discards that many leading draws of every listed chain as extra burn-in. Selection rules (decided 2026-10-28/29): chains that agree in fit and ranks are pooled; when one chain's mean log-likelihood beats the others by > 3 within-chain sd, only that chain is used (the voting-record check agreed with the log-likelihood in every such House); the chosen chain was then extended by 40k-80k draws with --resume.

100.rule: best of 4 chains (seed 2023); next best -208 loglik; liberal-edge placement of Schroeder/Clay/Sikorski confirmed by voting record

101.rule: best of 2 chains; other chain -322 loglik, trapped Schroeder/Bates/Pease/Moody at the centre

102.rule: best of 6 chains (seed 2026); voting record favours its placement of Jacobs (rank 1, agreement with neighbours 69% vs 59%)
102.drop_reason: chi_0 still settling over the first ~30k of 130k draws (0.123, 0.120, then 0.113-0.115)

notes: Schroeder: separate, non-overlapping modes across chains (rank 62-96 here vs 2-14 in another chain with loglik ~45 lower, about 1 sd); reported mode is the best-fitting chain's

104.rule: best of 6 chains (seed 2026); voting record favours its placement of Neumann and Roth at the far right

109.rule: best of 6 chains; all 6 agree within 14 ranks

113.rule: best of 2 chains; other chain -500 loglik, trapped Walter Jones at the centre

115.rule: best of 2 chains; other chain -535 loglik, trapped Walter Jones and Rod Blum at the centre

119.rule: pooled after +40k each (user decision) although chi_0 still differs between chains (0.329 vs 0.311)
notes: Congress ongoing: data up to the download date in provenance
